title: acer monspessulanum var. illyricum
intro: Acer monspessulanum var. illyricum, commonly known as the Serbian maple, is a deciduous tree or shrub belonging to the family Sapindaceae. The health benefits of the Serbian maple include its use in treating digestive issues, as it has anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to relieve gastrointestinal disorders, reduce fever, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of the Serbian maple include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
